story.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, beating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan
story.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate race, according to Al Jazeera, BBC World and NPR Politics. The excerpt says it was the last U.S. Senate contest resolved in this year's midterm elections and that Democrats flipped nine GOP-held seats to retake the chamber.

overlappingPost.author: jimlokay.com
overlappingPost.text: BREAKING: Mary Peltola wins election to the U.S. Senate from Alaska, projects the AP. Her win will give Democrats 56 seats in the new Congress.

Dan Koh: Congress Shouldn't Be a Get Rich Scheme!

Public service is supposed to serve the people, not politicians' stock portfolios.
Dan Koh says he is joining 50 incoming Democrats in demanding a ban on stock trading by members of Congress.
